name: Corporate Interior Fit-out
description: Six-phase structured process for commercial corporate fit-out interior design projects with AI co-pilot.

phases.name: Discovery & Brief
phases.description: Site visits, client interviews, headcount, department adjacencies, budget, and structured brief synthesis.

checklist.text: Site visit and initial walk-through completed
Client headcount and department requirements logged
Target fit-out budget and milestones confirmed
Meeting notes uploaded and structured brief verified

ai_actions.name: Draft Structured Brief
ai_actions.description: Extracts headcount, departments, adjacencies and budget from raw notes into structured fields.

phases.name: Space Planning
phases.description: Test-fit layouts on floor plate, circulation, room areas, and clearance rule checks.

checklist.text: Floor plate geometry and boundaries calibrated
Workstation clusters and circulation paths placed
Usable area metrics and clear egress paths confirmed

ai_actions.name: Generate Layout Options
ai_actions.description: Generates 3-5 test-fit configurations against designer clearance rules.

phases.name: Concept Design
phases.description: Mood boards, materiality, visual palette, and finish tagging.

checklist.text: Design direction and mood board curated
Material and finish palette tagged for downstream sourcing

ai_actions.name: Generate Concept Visuals
ai_actions.description: Creates rendered stylistic directions tailored to approved brief and space plan.

phases.name: Technical Documentation
phases.description: Construction coordination, schedules, specifications, and building regulation pre-checks.

checklist.text: Schedules populated from tagged concept items
Fire safety and accessibility compliance pre-check confirmed

ai_actions.name: Draft Schedule Specifications
ai_actions.description: Auto-populates technical specification descriptions from item references.

phases.name: Sourcing & FF&E
phases.description: Supplier quotations, RFQ generation, purchase order pipeline, and budget tracking.

checklist.text: RFQs drafted and dispatched to verified suppliers
Quotes vetted against project budget baseline

ai_actions.name: Import Supplier Specifications
ai_actions.description: Parses product dimensions, finishes and list prices from supplier web links.

phases.name: Delivery & Install
phases.description: Installation sequencing, on-site snag list resolution, client walkthrough and project handover.

checklist.text: Snag list inspection cleared with photos
Client walkthrough approved and handover dossier delivered

ai_actions.name: Generate Installation Checklist
ai_actions.description: Derives staged delivery and assembly order from FF&E dependencies.

handoffs.description: Client headcount and spatial requirements feed the space planning bounds
Validated floor plate dimensions guide concept visualization views
Tagged finishes flow directly into the construction schedule
Specified items become active procurement records
Supplier ETAs determine delivery and install timeline
